GitHub API 限流了（60 次/小时已用完）。改用网页抓取。

[tool-call run_code] {"timeoutMs": 300000, "code": "
const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
 "function get(u,acc){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':acc||'text/html'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
 " }).on('error',reject);",
 "});}",
 "function clean(s){return String(s||'').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim();}",
 "(async function(){",
 " const r=await get('https://github.com/sirlifehacker/n8n-automations');",
 " console.log('status', r.status, 'len', r.body.length);",
 " // 提取 README 内容",
 " const m=/<article[^>]*class=\"markdown-body[^\"]*\"[^>]*>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/article>/.exec(r.body);",
 " if(m){",
 " console.log('\\n=== README ===');",
 " console.log(clean(m[1]).substring(0,3500));",
 " } else {",
 " console.log('no article match; head:');",
 " console.log(clean(r.body).substring(0,1500));",
 " }",
 " // 文件列表",
 " const files=[...r.body.matchAll(/href=\"\\/sirlifehacker\\/n8n-automations\\/(?:blob|tree)\\/[^\"]*\\/([^\"/]+)\"/g)].map(function(x){return x[1]});",
 " console.log('\\n文件:', JSON.stringify([...new Set(files)].slice(0,30)));",
 "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-n8n2.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-n8n2.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch n8n repo README from web", timeoutMs: 200000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 7000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));

const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
  "function get(u,acc){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':acc||'text/html'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
  "  }).on('error',reject);",
  "});}",
  "function clean(s){return String(s||'').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim();}",
  "(async function(){",
  "  const r=await get('https://github.com/sirlifehacker/n8n-automations');",
  "  console.log('status', r.status, 'len', r.body.length);",
  "  // 提取 README 内容",
  "  const m=/<article[^>]*class=\"markdown-body[^\"]*\"[^>]*>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/article>/.exec(r.body);",
  "  if(m){",
  "    console.log('\\n=== README ===');",
  "    console.log(clean(m[1]).substring(0,3500));",
  "  } else {",
  "    console.log('no article match; head:');",
  "    console.log(clean(r.body).substring(0,1500));",
  "  }",
  "  // 文件列表",
  "  const files=[...r.body.matchAll(/href=\"\\/sirlifehacker\\/n8n-automations\\/(?:blob|tree)\\/[^\"]*\\/([^\"/]+)\"/g)].map(function(x){return x[1]});",
  "  console.log('\\n文件:', JSON.stringify([...new Set(files)].slice(0,30)));",
  "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-n8n2.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-n8n2.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch n8n repo README from web", timeoutMs: 200000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 7000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));
